location_address: 1677 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109
description:
Booking minimum of 3 adults.

Join us for a snorkel safari! We'll take you out on a photo safari off of San Diego, where you can get up close and personal with incredible marine wildlife in and out of the water!
itinerary:
1.) Meet at 1677 Quivira Rd, at Seaforth Marina gate
2.) Safety briefing at boat
3.) Gear up at dock, usually half-way put on wetsuit, stage snorkel gear.
3.) Leave out of Mission Bay to look for marine life in the Pacific Ocean!
4.) Snorkel with incredible marine life!
5.) Return to Seaforth Marina.
